claims.text: The latest Pulumi CLI release is v3.263.0, released 2026-09-16 (the comparison table at L134 lists v3.261.0 released 2026-09-02, an inconsistency with the later table and the Pulumi section).
The latest stable Terraform release is v1.16.3, released 2026-09-16 (the summary table at L135 lists v1.16.1, 2026-09-02).
The latest stable AWS CDK release is v2.270.0, released 2026-09-17 (the summary table at L136 lists v2.268.0, 2026-09-02).
The latest stable Azure Bicep release is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08 (the at-a-glance table at L139 still lists v0.46.1, 2026-07-30).
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable Crossplane release is v2.4.1, released 2026-09-15 (the at-a-glance table at L142 lists v2.4.0, 2026-08-20).
The latest stable OpenTofu release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19.
The version and release-date figures in the table were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
The at-a-glance table's latest stable release column is accurate as of 2026-09-21.
The pricing table reflects published pricing as of September 2026.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
Env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
env0 was renamed to env zero.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.
Governing bodies: Pulumi is governed by Pulumi Corporation, Terraform by HashiCorp (an IBM company), AWS CDK by AWS, Kubernetes and Crossplane by the CNCF, and OpenTofu by the Linux Foundation.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager will be fully turned down on June 30, 2027 for workloads still migrating.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month, including 40 credits and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month, including 400 credits and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise pricing is custom and contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then moves to per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Self-hosted Terraform Enterprise is available at custom pricing.
The pricing figures were checked on 2026-09-21.

By GitHub stars, Kubernetes leads at roughly 127,900 stars; among dedicated IaC tools Terraform is most-starred at ~49,700, followed by OpenTofu ~30,200, Pulumi ~25,700, AWS CDK ~12,900, Crossplane ~12,100 (measured 2026-09-21).
Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption.
Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure management, respectively.
Open-source tools including OpenTofu, Kubernetes, and Crossplane are free to run; cloud-native tools like CDK, CloudFormation, ARM, Bicep, and Infrastructure Manager carry no separate tool fee.
